metadata.description: A portable senior UI/UX designer Agent Skill: brief in, a justified, accessible, mobile-first Interface & Journey Guide out. No code, no stack lock-in.

plugins.name: ui-ux-designer
plugins.description: Senior UI/UX designer skill. Turns a brief, backlog, module or redesign request into a justified, accessible, mobile-first Interface & Journey Guide (design system, three-layer tokens, screen-by-screen specs, nine states, motion, UX copy, data-viz, WCAG 2.1 AA). Derives the art direction from the subject or a palette you provide; never writes code and never chooses the tech stack.
